# Analysis for outputs required by PMDA in oncology

`{anaume}` is a package to generate outputs required in oncology therapeutic area by PMDA.

```{r}
library(anaume)
```

# Setup for dummy data

Dummy data are based on the `pharmaverseadam` package. Install it with
`install.packages("pharmaverseadam")` to run the examples below.

```{r}
adae <- pharmaverseadam::adae
adsl <- pharmaverseadam::adsl
```

# Define types of AE to be analyzed

Use `make_ae_type()` to define each adverse event category to summarize.
A category can be unconditional (all AEs) or defined by a filtering condition.

```{r}
ae_types <- list(
  make_ae_type("any_ae", "Any AE"),
  make_ae_type("rel_ae", "Related AEs", AEREL == "Y")
)
```

# Generate ARD

Pass the data, denominator, and AE types to `jpn_query_overview()` to create an
analysis-ready data (ARD) object summarized at the AETYPE level.

```{r}
jpn_query_overview(
  data        = adae,
  denominator = adsl,
  ae_types    = ae_types,
  by          = TRT01A
)
```
